This '''[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]''' was in charge of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] c. [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. His assets were harassed by raids of the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], to the point that he was forced to ask for a fleet as reinforcements.

==Behind the scenes==
The moff of Fakir sector that felt harassed by the Roughnecks as described in "The Long Shot Campaign" has not been identified; but other sources mention moff [[Lorin]] as the person in charge of Fakir at least at some point of the Rebellion era.<ref name="MTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> The unidentified moff could also be Governor General Lord [[Dixton]], but the probable outcome of the adventure ''Tests of the Godking'' would mean that Dixton was captured by the Roughnecks in what appeared to be their first encounter.
